suggestions.roleTitleVi: Nhà sản xuất nông nghiệp sạch và cung ứng nông sản địa phương
suggestions.reasoning: As digital transformation reshapes traditional supply chains, localized expertise in sustainable farming combined with direct market engagement offers high resilience against AI automation. According to World Bank (2024), agricultural adaptation requires leveraging local knowledge and digital extension tools, shielding physical agronomy roles from direct software replacement.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: With 20 years of hands-on rice farming and deep local knowledge in An Giang, you already master water management and crop cultivation. This path builds directly on your strengths of hard work and resilience, helping you transition into clean agriculture and direct local produce business without needing heavy technology or English skills.
transferableSkillsMatch: Hard work and harsh condition endurance

trajectories.pathTitle: Traditional Farming Augmented with Clean Practices
trajectories.pathTitleVi: Canh tác truyền thống kết hợp phương pháp sạch
trajectories.shortDescription: Gradually integrate clean agricultural techniques into your existing rice farming to improve yield quality and reduce chemical costs.
trajectories.rationale: Keeps risk minimal by utilizing existing land and 20 years of farming experience.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Learn one new organic fertilizer method for the upcoming crop season.

trajectories.pathTitleVi: Cung cấp nông sản sạch trực tiếp cho người tiêu dùng
trajectories.shortDescription: Transition part of your harvest toward clean produce and sell directly to local markets or consumer groups to bypass intermediaries.
trajectories.rationale: Reduces dependency on commercial middlemen and increases profit margins.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Identify three potential local buyers interested in clean rice or vegetables.

trajectories.pathTitleVi: Chuyên gia hợp tác xã nông nghiệp
trajectories.shortDescription: Join and take an active advisory role in a local An Giang agricultural cooperative focusing on sustainable farming.
trajectories.rationale: Requires community networking and coordination beyond individual farming.
trajectories.actionStepNow: Visit your local agricultural commune office to learn about cooperative programs.
